_comment: g6006_285-class guard (2026-08-21): the Silence-Remedy-Silence re-arm interleave. Board: Remedy live, unsick Hierarch, Temple Garden + Godless Shrine untapped. Hand: Invigorate + 2x Reverent Silence + redundant Remedy + Windswept Heath. Opp 20. Kill (exact 20): Heath->shock, Invigorate alt (drip 3 + pump), attack 5, then Silence (-6, wipes Remedy1), RECAST Remedy2 ({2}{B} off the 3 lands), Silence2 (-6). Order is everything: canonical enabler-first casts Remedy2 BEFORE the Silences, the first wipe kills BOTH Remedies and the second Silence GIFTS 6. ApplyEnablerWipeRecheck produces the re-arm order; its old `order.size() < 4` fast-out skipped this 3-cast backed form, which is the post-combat kill shape under the enforced main split -- so the split arm could not see this T3 kill at any budget. Depth 1 (the greedy d0 solver cannot assemble the interleave -- a separate, pre-existing limitation in BOTH arms).
